aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but misidentifies the primary comparison and over-groups noisy RAW DATA measurements.
issues: Changed factor uses shift as test condition instead of test item/type context.
Baseline/test labels are ambiguous between Normal and Frame Test.
RAW DATA SPL/THD stats are unverified and not clearly tied to the function-defect result.
Review title is an extracted RAW DATA row, not the report subject.
Measurement subresults include header/spec artifacts as numeric stats.
requiredUserQuestions: Is the intended comparison Normal vs TIU C11-20L Frame Test?
Should RAW DATA SPL/THD soundcheck results be included in this same review case?
correctionPlan: Rename title from Test sheet report title.
Set changed factor to the validated frame/function condition, with date and shift as subgroup keys.
Keep Test!15 and Test!17 as the function-defect comparison evidence.
Remove or separately regroup RAW DATA measurement outcomes unless tied to the same validation.
Rebuild measurement stats using proper headers, frequency rows, samples, and masks.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but cited rows are insufficient for final evidence until grouping is corrected.
